8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8 8'''
g=[list(map(int,x.split())) for x in s.splitlines()]
def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
 # blocks defined by non-8 cells including zeros: find rect regions adjacent in row/col, using all cells !=8
 cells={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=8}
 comps=[]
 while cells:
  stack=[cells.pop()]; comp=set(stack)
  while stack:
   r,c=stack.pop()
   for q in ((r+1,c),(r-1,c),(r,c+1),(r,c-1)):
    if q in cells: cells.remove(q);comp.add(q);stack.append(q)
  comps.append(comp)
 for comp in comps:
  colors={grid[r][c] for r,c in comp}-{0}
  if not colors: continue
  color=next(iter(colors)); rs=[r for r,c in comp];cs=[c for r,c in comp]
  r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
  pix=[(r,c) for r,c in comp if grid[r][c]==color]
  pr0=min(r for r,c in pix);pc0=min(c for r,c in pix);pr1=max(r for r,c in pix);pc1=max(c for r,c in pix)
  ph,pw=pr1-pr0+1,pc1-pc0+1
  pat={(r-pr0,c-pc0) for r,c in pix}
  for r in range(r0,r1+1):
   for c in range(c0,c1+1):
    if (r,c) in comp and grid[r][c] in (0,color) and ((r-pr0)%ph,(c-pc0)%pw) in pat: out[r][c]=color
 return out
out=transform(g)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))
